'''Yavin 4: Jungle''' is a [[Light]] [[Location]] ([[Site]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ヤヴィン４：ジャングル</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ライトサイド：反乱軍が単独で戦闘すれば、戦闘力に＋２、損耗の対象にならない。ダークサイド：ここを占領していれば、フォース消耗に＋１。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-137o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja"></span>''<ref name="jp-face" />

'''Title:''' Yavin 4: Jungle.

'''Card text:''' Light Side: A Rebel battling alone is power +2 and immune to attrition. Dark Side: If you occupy here, add 1 to the Force drain.
